run_export_dm21_saved_model: run the CLI to export the DM21 functional and its derivatives to a TensorFlow SavedModel
run_export_custom_functional: run the CLI with a custom functional type and batch size to export a SavedModel
export_functional_and_derivatives: call export to save a functional and its derivatives to a SavedModel at a given path
review_export_function: review the export function that creates a NeuralNumInt instance and exports the functional
summarize_main_cli_entry: summarize the main function that parses flags and calls export with the configured functional
